ops.prevDaySetup: When loading in or out from the day before, for exhibitions and similar events, a percentage of the all-day rate is charged. Load-in before 18:00 the day before: 80%; from 18:00 the day before: 50%; from 22:00 the day before: 20%. Load-out before 22:00 on the day is included in the all-day rate; load-out by 7:00 the next day: 10%; load-out by 12:00 the next day: 50%. Use before 7:00 and after 22:00 is charged at the standard rate plus 50%. (Source: Ballroom price list, rates from April 1, 2026)
ops.parking: 375 spaces on B3 and B4 of the hotel. Vehicle height 2.3 m or less (2.1 m in some areas), length 6.0 m or less, width 2.0 m or less. General rates: 6:00-24:00 is 500 yen per 30 minutes, 0:00-6:00 is 200 yen per 30 minutes, with a maximum of 4,000 yen per 12 hours. Attendees of banquets and weddings receive a 3-hour service ticket. (Source: Access page, as of October 2024)
ops.restaurants: The hotel has the Japanese restaurant "Japanese Cuisine Sakuragaoka", the ryotei "Cerulean Tower Sukiya", the Chinese restaurant "szechwan restaurant Chin", the teppanyaki restaurant "Sakura", the sushi restaurant "Itoh Ikkan", the Towers Restaurant "Cucagna", the Garden Kitchen "Karumera" and others. For banquets and parties there are banquet plans such as the Towers Buffet Plan, Towers Course Plan and Buffet Plan.
